generation.scope: A smooth integral quintic point graph with disjoint isolated residual in a four-edge point-fiber finite Frobenius candidate must be elliptic with empty residual. In genus two the opposite contraction forces two alternating Weierstrass polarizations. Cyclic parity then forces three common commutators, giving an impossible complete intersection of degree eight supported on a sextic.

open_mathematics: Determine the elliptic quintic multiplication kernels and the restrictions on projection centers from the opposite cubic and trisecants. Higher opposite rank finite graphs, other curve degrees and uncontrolled components remain open.
